The House Committee on Agriculture Bill 449 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Rhodes of the 124th, Ridley of the 6th, Hitchens of the 161st, Smith of the 70th, Williams of the 148th, and Consumer Affairs offers the following substitute to HB 449: others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to public utilities and public transportation, so as to subject the rates and charges for water services provided through … or subject such entities to the jurisdiction of the commission. Reserved."
SECTION 2. This Act shall become effective on January 1, 2026.
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
